plainSummary: The plan lets users choose their agent’s steps while keeping approval and proof requirements intact.
summary: Independent sl-plan-break-spec and security spec review used CLI related W-012 --worktrees pack (3 features, 11 claims, related W008 workflow and W010 browser-action boundaries, W011 navigation). Reviewed preview content identity, concurrent selection conflicts, repeated save identity, required typed review outputs, local skill path confinement and browser origin/token checks. Requested explicit security model; shaper added principals, untrusted inputs, enforcing components and persisted-selection negative assertions before this stamp. Stage order and missing mandatory output contracts must be enforced in workflow domain, not merely UI validation. UI-to-shared-operation save plus CLI/MCP observation, keyboard/narrow flow and stable section navigation are required acceptance evidence.
residualRisks: Tool related pack supplied a caution-only worktree note without scan status or entries; no sibling checkout state was used as authority.
No code has been independently verified at spec review time; cross-origin rejection and unchanged selections require runtime negative tests.
Saving guidance does not establish agent compliance or launch a host runner; local filesystem writers remain outside the cooperative boundary.
